en-US: Render PDF attachments correctly in the desktop app after updating its compatibility runtime.
Keep the note list usable when one note fails to render, and recover safely without reopening the failing note after restart.
zh-CN: 更新桌面端兼容运行时，确保 PDF 附件能够正常渲染。
单篇笔记渲染失败时保持笔记列表可用，并在重启后安全恢复，避免再次打开异常笔记。
